items.q: What is Tina Huang's core AI tool philosophy?
items.a: Master a **small core set deeply** instead of chasing every release. "Have a core set of tools that you know how to use **really, really well** as opposed to try to chase the hype."

items.q: How does she organize her stack?
items.a: As a **life map** with four zones — **home base**, builder dungeon, Octopus HQ, content studio — not by vendor or category label.
**Claude Cowork** no-code workflow: email + Slack + calendar + portfolio + daily focus in one pass, plus investment dashboards.

items.q: When does she reach for Perplexity over Claude?
items.a: For **multi-source objective search** (sneakers, dentists, product comparisons) — and in Hong Kong where Claude/Gemini/OpenAI need VPN but **Perplexity does not**.

items.q: How does she choose among coding tools?
items.a: Intensity ladder: **Claude Code** (deep autonomous codebase work) → **Warp** (multi-agent orchestration) → **Cursor** (familiar IDE) → **Codex** (specialized / bundled subscriptions). **Bolt** for quick prototypes; **Retool** for business-specific internal apps.

items.q: Why run a Mac Studio for local models?
items.a: **M4 64GB** hosts Qwen, Llama, GLM, MiniMax **24/7** for private/free inference — critical for accounting/tax/banking tools that need **exact workflow fit** and privacy.

items.q: How does she build custom agents?
items.a: Cowork + **Hermes** (open-source local) for workflows; **n8n** for no-code agents; OpenAI SDK for code path. **SerpAPI** feeds Hermes news tracking, slide generator, and resource tools (250 free credits at signup).

items.q: What is Cowork's role for the Lonely Octopus team?
items.a: Notification hub across **Discord, Notion, Slack, email**; Notion AI for doc search; Google Workspace + Gemini for meetings; **Whisperflow** for voice input.

items.q: Does AI replace her on-camera work?
items.a: No — "What you see here, **100% human**." Hermes scans Reddit/X/HN/Instagram/YouTube for rising topics → alerts + research outlines; Cowork for graphics; human deep-dive, film, and edit.
Internal chat trained on **all her public content** for team FAQ — RAG-style retrieval, not decision-making. Prompt mnemonics: **TCREI / RSTI** ("tiny crabs ride enormous iguanas…").
